Name: Fixed Luau Bridge
Author: AirynS
Description:
This is a minor immersive tweak mod that simply makes the fixed plank bridge to the eastern half of the beach visible and crossable at the luau instead of mysteriously being broken again. Additionally, if Ridgeside Village is installed and you've fixed the bridge before the luau, the double plank bridge added to the luau by RSV's festival maps will remain permanently in place afterwards.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] Fixed Luau Bridge" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

Thanks to Max for help with the map and Kedi for answering questions about the RSV feature!

I have not tested it with SVE. It likely is compatible but I won't provide compat if it's not. Questions asking about SVE compatibility will be deleted.
